research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mazama appears to be researching systems and processes for stimulating subterranean geologic formations to create an artificial stress barrier and enhancing connectivity and permeability between injector and producer wells using sequenced stimulation in enhanced geothermal systems. They also work on methods of forming a permeable proppant pack in a geothermal formation at high temperature. Together these efforts target geothermal reservoir stimulation, flow connectivity, and high temperature proppant technology.

product_launches.description: Mazama Energy unveiled a proprietary Thermal Lattice enhanced geothermal system at its Newberry, Oregon pilot site, demonstrating the world’s hottest EGS at 629°F (331°C) and positioning it as a platform for future commercial power projects.

about_short_description.short_description: Mazama Energy is a geothermal operator and development firm committed to developing new techniques and technology for removing heat.

product.name: MUSE™
product.description: An integrated superhot-rock geothermal energy system combining drilling, reservoir stimulation, and well-performance modeling to recover heat for electricity generation.

identifier.value: Superhot Rock Enhanced Geothermal System Development

product.name: Superhot Rock Enhanced Geothermal System Development
product.description: Development of engineered geothermal reservoirs in rocks exceeding 374°C to generate electricity from deep subsurface heat.

product.name: Thermal Lattice™
product.description: A reservoir stimulation technique that improves connectivity between injection and production wells in superhot-rock geothermal systems.

product.name: Mazama Drill
product.description: Proprietary drilling technology for precise, efficient horizontal well paths in superhot rock geothermal formations.

product.name: Heat Harvester™
product.description: Well-performance modeling technology that predicts changes in well integrity and heat production over time.

product.name: Mazama EMPOWER
product.description: An economic development and readiness program connecting local businesses and workers with geothermal drilling and field-operation opportunities.
